mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_tbl(admin_id, admin_pw, admin_dept, admin_email, admin_phone) VALUES (#{admin_id}, #{admin_pw}, #{admin_dept}, #{admin_email}, #{admin_phone})
mapper.select: SELECT admin_id FROM admin_tbl WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id}
SELECT admin_id, admin_pw, admin_dept, admin_email, admin_phone, admin_datesub, admin_updatedate, admin_visit_date FROM admin_tbl WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_tbl SET admin_visit_date = SYSDATE WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_tbl WHERE ord_regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS today_order_count, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ord_price), 0) FROM order_tbl WHERE ord_regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS today_sales, (SELECT NVL(SUM(ord_price), 0) FROM order_tbl WHERE ord_regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS month_sales, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tbl WHERE user_datesub >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS today_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payinfo_tbl WHERE p_status = '미납') AS unpaid_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payinfo_tbl WHERE p_status IN ('결제완료', '배송준비중')) AS shipping_wait_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_tbl) AS product_count FROM dual

SELECT ord_code, user_id, ord_name, ord_price, ord_regdate, p_status FROM ( SELECT o.ord_code, o.user_id, o.ord_name, o.ord_price, o.ord_regdate, p.p_status FROM order_tbl o LEFT OUTER JOIN payinfo_tbl p ON o.ord_code = p.ord_code ORDER BY o.ord_code DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT pro_num, pro_name, pro_amount, pro_buy FROM ( SELECT pro_num, pro_name, pro_amount, pro_buy FROM product_tbl WHERE pro_amount <= 5 ORDER BY pro_amount ASC, pro_num DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
